data.title: Iran president offers US olive branch before Putin meeting
data.description: BISHKEK (KYRGYZSTAN) - Iran's President Masoud Pezeshkian on Tuesday vowed to match any US move to return to a June deal aimed at ending their war, as he prepares to meet Russian counterpart Vladimir Putin at a regional summit.

data.title: China-Nepal flood toll tops 1,000 as tunnel rescue offers last hope
data.description: NUWAKOT — The death toll from devastating Himalayan glacial floods crossed the grim 1,000 mark on Tuesday, as Chinese and Nepali teams searched for survivors including dozens feared trapped in hydropower tunnels.

data.title: Autumn flavours come to life at The Authors’ Lounge Bangkok
data.description: Mandarin Oriental Bangkok celebrates autumn at The Authors’ Lounge with seasonal afternoon tea, fresh scones and desserts from September 1 to November 30.

data.title: Cannabis, watersports ban for US sailors visiting Pattaya
data.description: Cannabis and most watersports are on the "banned" list for the thousands of US navy personnel from the carrier group visiting Chon Buri and Pattaya this week.

data.title: Nepal's wall of missing offers last hope after Himalayan flood
data.description: KATHMANDU — In Nepal's capital, desperate people searching for family members missing after Wednesday's devastating floods post photographs on a wall, clinging to a final, fading hope of finding them.

data.title: Defence tech hub Munich booms as Europe rearms
data.description: MUNICH — Munich is booming as a hub for young defence tech firms making everything from AI-powered drones to cutting-edge military software as Europe rearms to face an increasingly dangerous world.

data.title: Buri Ram prison suspends visits after positive Covid tests
data.description: BURI RAM - Nang Rong Prison has suspended family visits to three of its zones for one month after around 50 inmates tested positive for Covid-19 and several others were found to have scabies.

data.title: ONE Championship: Nabil Anane’s kickboxing return against Yuki Yoza set for Samurai 4
data.description: Nabil Anane will make the kickboxing return he floated after consecutive Muay Thai defeats when he faces Yuki Yoza at ONE Samurai 4 in Tokyo on October 17.

data.title: Many data centres in Bangkok built without permission, says digital minister
data.description: Many data centres were operating without permission in Bangkok, with authorities investigating fuel stockpiling and possible foreign investment in the facilities, Digital Economy and Society (DES) Minister Chaichanok Chidchob said on Tuesday.

data.title: Fire guts 15 homes in Makkasan community, one dead
data.description: A fire tore through a residential community in Soi Sukhumvit 3, Makkasan sub-district, Ratchathewi district, in the early hours of Tuesday, killing one person and damaging about 15 houses.

data.title: Vacheron Constantin’s newest collection is a tribute to the animal kingdom
data.description: Six extraordinary timepieces transform rare decorative crafts into tiny scenes of the natural world, pushing centuries-old artisanal techniques to microscopic proportions.

data.title: Nigeria rethinks criminalisation of suicide
data.description: LAGOS - In Nigeria, surviving a suicide attempt can mean facing not only the trauma of the ordeal but also the threat of prosecution.

data.title: 'Massive' Russian missile, drone attack on Kyiv kills 8
data.description: KYIV (UKRAINE) - A "massive" Russian attack killed at least eight people in Kyiv overnight, including seven at a railways depot, officials said Tuesday, as Moscow pressed its air campaign on the Ukrainian capital and surrounding areas.

data.title: US teen charged with aiding mosque shooters share livestream, manifesto
data.description: NORTH CAROLINA — A jury charged a teen in the US state of North Carolina on Monday with allegedly aiding two other teenagers livestream their shooting rampage of a mosque on the other side of the country in May.

data.title: “Lisa Effect” Turns Thailand’s Travel Dreams into Real Search Demand
data.description: Traveloka data suggests TAT’s Lisa-led “Feel All the Feelings” campaign is gaining momentum, with searches and bookings rising for Thai destinations from Udon Thani to Rayong.

data.title: Pattaya Turns 365 Days of Events into a World-Class City Strategy
data.description: Pattaya is using year-round events across sport, music, culture, pride, wellness and business travel to raise its profile as a world-class event city and strengthen Thailand’s tourism economy.

data.title: Pinehurst Reframes Golf as "Science-Backed Wellness" for Modern Lifestyles
data.description: Amid growing interest in health and wellness—particularly cardiovascular health and stroke prevention—one question increasingly facing people today may not simply be, “What exercise should I do?” but rather, “How can I choose an activity that I can enjoy consistently and that fits naturally into my lifestyle?”

data.title: Man dies in fall from escalator at Bangkok shopping centre
data.description: A man believed to be in his 30s died in a fall from a moving escalator at a shopping centre near Asok intersection in Bangkok on Monday night.

data.title: Popular Thi Lo Su waterfall reopens in Tak
data.description: TAK - The magnificent Thi Lo Su waterfall in Umphang district reopened to the public on Tuesday after being closed for two months to allow natural rehabilitation - but only for four-wheel-drive vehicles.

data.title: US Army Secretary Driscoll submits resignation: White House
data.description: WASHINGTON — US Army Secretary Dan Driscoll has submitted his resignation, the White House confirmed Monday, following reports of tensions with Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth.
